answer: Price trust by graph shape, not volume. Each identity gains influence from attestations, but endorsements from attesters who all vouch for one another get discounted as a cartel. A sybil farm's fakes survive only by inter-vouching, which marks them as a dense mutual cluster: the denser the mutual praise, the deeper the discount, so each added fake shrinks the cluster's value instead of growing it — a lone knoll of fraud. Honest agents collect scattered, unconnected endorsements, as dispersed as a plume on the wind, which forgery cannot mass-produce, leaving the reward vault sealed to clones.
